scope: C-line multi-signal scan offline preparation; no RF, no board, no flash, no training

scan.note_step: tuning step is NOT inherently a multiple of 2500 Hz (contract sec. 3, 2026-10-29 revision): impose no multiple restriction unless the real receiver/controller has a verified alignment premise; spectral stitching uses real integer-Hz coordinates
scan.note_max_step: 2304000 = 0.9 * 2560000 is the main-chain EXISTING scan span / upper limit (ScanConfig.validate value); it is NOT fs and NOT a bin-alignment requirement -- keep the real frequency coordinate, do not force 2302500

multi_target_resolution.status: OFFLINE TEST TARGETS (board verification pending, NOT frozen commitments)
multi_target_resolution.note: separation and dynamic-range numbers are Hann-window PSD model targets to be re-verified against the REAL public-frame occupied bandwidth, guard band and detection algorithm before any claim

power_contract.source: detection PSD peak power minus the dwell's adaptive median noise floor (prominence of the selected peak)
power_contract.unit: dB above adaptive median noise floor (relative scale; NOT dBm, NOT dBFS)
power_contract.valid_means: a value >= 14 dB means a valid detection (the detector only reports peaks >= median + 14 dB); NaN/absent means unmeasured or invalid
power_contract.no_dbm: no absolute metrological contract exists offline, so dBm must never be reported from this field

aging.note: drop after N consecutive revisit cycles without re-detection

dwell.note_dwell_budget: offline upper bound; board-measured dwell time to be filled during RF phase

assumptions: TX baseband sample rate == RX sample rate (board-verified pending)
real public-frame train/tail occupied bandwidth VERIFIED offline 2026-10-29 = FULL-BAND QPSK (~2.56 MHz Nyquist, -20 dB occupied BW ~1.00x fs); NOT <=10 kHz
offline TX synthesis uses a narrow-band stand-in carrier that does NOT represent the real public frame; real payload waveform occupied bandwidth still pending (dataset-defined, not in this tree)

non_committed: overlapping signals closer than 12500 Hz: separation NOT promised (12500 Hz is an offline test target pending board verification)
a neighbour weaker than 25 dB below an adjacent strong signal: separation NOT promised (25 dB is an offline test target pending board verification)
signals in different tuning bands or beyond a single TX/RX instantaneous bandwidth require extra hardware
rapid TX retuning is NOT simultaneous multi-signal
list timestamps are sequential tuning times, NOT simultaneous identifications
